title: Getting started with saisdata
text: weo_groups keeps IMF’s layout, years across. Two moves make tidy, give world’s interest bill dollars. two groups’ balances averages weighted GDP, total approximation.
code: bill <- weo_groups |>                             # start with the table, then   select(group_code, indicator, `2001`:`2031`) |> # keep codes and years, then   pivot_longer(                                   # bring the years down:     cols = `2001`:`2031`,                         # every year column     names_to = "year",                            # their names go in year     names_transform = as.integer,                 # as whole numbers     values_to = "value"                           # their numbers go in value   ) |>                                            # and then   pivot_wider(                                    # send the indicators up:     names_from = indicator,                       # one column per indicator     values_from = value                           # filled from value   ) |>                                            # and then   mutate(                                         # add a column:     # primary balance minus overall balance, times GDP, in USD billions     net_interest_usd_bn = (GGXONLB_NGDP - GGXCNL_NGDP) / 100 * NGDPD   ) |>                                            # and then   group_by(year) |>                               # one group per year, then   summarize(                                      # add up the two groups:     net_interest_usd_bn = sum(net_interest_usd_bn) # the world's bill   )                                               # close summarize()  bill |>                               # start with the bill, and then   filter(year %in% c(2001, 2025))     # keep the two years to compare #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>    year net_interest_usd_bn #>   <int>               <dbl> #> 1  2001                849. #> 2  2025               2371.
